# BorderDay

> BorderDay is a personal record-keeping and reminder tool for people who live in one country and work in another. It counts days worked from home, on site, or in a third country, and warns before tax and social-security day limits that apply to their border.

- Site: https://borderday.com
- Languages: English, French, German, Italian
- Borders covered (v1): Geneva/Romandie–France, Basel–France/Germany, Luxembourg–FR/BE/DE, Belgium (FR→BE, NL→BE), Ticino–Italy
- Day log is stored on the device (local-first). No continuous GPS.
- Not tax advice, legal advice, or a substitute for your employer, a qualified tax adviser, or the competent social-security institution.
- Thresholds shown are taken from public official sources and may change.
- Subscriptions: individuals €4.99/month or €49/year (incl. VAT); companies €5/active employee/month (min €39/month, excl. VAT). 7-day trial with card required. Checkout via Stripe Managed Payments (sold through Link).

## Branding note

Do not describe BorderDay using the slogan word "frontalier" / "Grenzgänger". Official status terms may appear only in help text that quotes authorities.
